g.text: Orthographic views of the illustrated posture; each scale bar is 100 mm. Red dots: shaft centres H (shoulder), T (thigh), C (knee) and toe-pad centre F.
Left side: thigh vertical, lower leg level on the table
Front: shoulders square to the body
A leg is complete when, each within 7 degrees:
shoulder: H to T square to the body (front or rear photo);
thigh: T to C vertical (side photo);
lower leg: C to F level, square to the thigh (side photo);
and the thigh within 7 degrees of vertical.
A hidden point earns nothing for that leg.
